column1: # planning/fidelity/popover.pairing.tsv — which build node answers which mock affordance.
# Four tab-separated columns:  state <TAB> affordance <TAB> node <TAB> citation
# This file declares ONLY the pairing. It never declares a status: present, divergent, absent and
# unclassified are computed by scripts/acceptance/mock_fidelity.py from the two artifacts on every
# run, which is what makes `present` earned by measuring rather than asserted.
#   node = -            the affordance has no counterpart in the build, or none this surface
#                       instruments — the citation says which, and they are not the same thing
#   affordance = +path  a build node with no counterpart in the mock, cited
# READ THE MANIFEST'S `note` FIRST. As of 2026-08-23 the engine CANNOT RUN against this surface:
# `mock-affordances.py` needs a `.v-<state>` frame inside the section and `#statusPopover` has none,
# so `mock-fidelity-gate.sh popover` exits 3 with `error: #statusPopover has no '.v-ideal' block`.
# The affordance ids below were derived by driving that script's own `SurfaceParser` over the sliced
# `#statusPopover` fragment, so they are what it will produce once it can slice this surface — 14
# rows, matching the manifest's floor. They are not hand-invented.
# THE ONE DIVERGENCE THIS FILE CANNOT CARRY AS A ROW: `Resident 214 MB`. The mock's four header count
# cells are plain divs with `small muted` / `mono` and match none of the derivation rules, so the
# inventory holds no affordance for any of them — including the one number in this popover that does
# not ship. It is enforced structurally instead: `MenuBarPresentation.Counts` has no field a memory
# figure could come from, asserted by reflection in `MenuBarPresentationTests.headerHasNoSkillsField`,
# because `residentMb()` in `src/pool.ts` has zero callers and never reaches the wire. Declared here
# as D1 so a later reader does not conclude the gate examined it.
# The three counts the build DOES draw are build-only rows below, for the same reason: they answer no
# derivable affordance, and criterion 5 — no number the popover renders is absent from the wire — is
# about exactly them.

column4: D2 · DIVERGENT BY DECISION. The mock draws this `btn primary` (accent fill, white label) at design/mcp-router-console.html:1486 and plan-M20.md step 13 says "(prominent)". The build draws it StandardButtonStyle in the mock's leading position. DESIGN.md:212 binds accent exposure to a live accessibility deviation — --on-accent on --accent is a recorded contrast shortfall pinned by LightAppearanceTests.darkOnAccentDeviationIsPinned — and bounds it to "one prominent accent-filled action per view". The band caps at MenuBarPresentation.inboxBandLimit = 3 rows and the footer's Open MCP Router already holds this view's prominent slot, so prominence here would put two to four accent fills in the smallest surface in the app. The same passage names the substitute: "distinguished by shape and position too, never by colour alone."
